newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Hannaford raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Hannaford raised to buy.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan said it raised its recommendation on Hannaford Bros Co to buy from market perform.

-- The New England supermarket chain was raised because, "The combination of denser store configurations, better capacity utilization in (a) new warehouse, and comparisons with hurrican-torn third quarter numbers is highly positive for Hannaford," according to analyst Mark Husson's research note.
-- Hannaford shares rose 3/8 to 35-1/4 in morning New York Stock Exchange trade, a new year-high.
-- 1997 earnings estimate was raised $0.02 per share to $2.11 and the 1998 estimate is unchanged at $2.48 per share.
